name: iFOREX Financial Trading Holdings Ltd.
summary: Operating as a financial technology powerhouse, iFOREX Financial Trading Holdings Ltd. specializes in creating and managing an advanced online and mobile platform dedicated to Contract for Difference (CFD) trading. This platform empowers individual investors to engage with a diverse array of financial instruments, including foreign exchange, raw materials, market indices, company shares, digital currencies, and exchange-traded funds. Beyond offering a vast selection of tradable assets spanning numerous sectors and global markets, the company provides essential resources such as up-to-the-minute financial news, daily market analyses, and an economic calendar to aid its users. Internally, the platform incorporates sophisticated risk monitoring capabilities, seamless payment solutions, and proprietary marketing technology designed to optimize client acquisition, retention, and overall management. iFOREX Financial Trading Holdings Ltd. maintains a significant global footprint, conducting operations across Asia, Europe, Latin America, and the Middle East and Africa. Established in 1996, the firm, initially named IPEC Holdings Ltd., rebranded as iFOREX Financial Trading Holdings Ltd. in May 2025. Its headquarters are located in Saint Peter Port, Guernsey.
